project_type: Next.js 14 App Router with Prisma ORM and SQLite
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npx prisma generate to generate Prisma client. 3. Run npx prisma db push to create database. 4. Run pnpm build to verify TypeScript compilation. 5. Run pnpm dev to verify the app starts and renders.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/dev.db (SQLite database file, generated by prisma db push). node_modules/.prisma/client (generated by prisma generate).
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform && pnpm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - can install npm packages. Node.js 22 available. pnpm available. SQLite used instead of PostgreSQL/Supabase for local development (Prisma makes provider swap trivial later).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists yet. This is a greenfield build.
key_patterns: Design reference uses Propela Purple #5B2D8E as primary brand color. Poppins font. Color coding for Next Action urgency (Red=Overdue, Amber=Due Today, Teal=Upcoming, Grey=No action). Readiness Status color coding (Grey=Not Ready, Green=Placement Ready, Purple=Placed). Gallery is default view. Photo-first Airtable-style cards.
directory_structure: Root: Next.js app (to be created). design-reference/: Claude design artifacts with JSX mockups showing UI patterns, color system, and component structure.
